name: Ariake (Nagasaki, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ariake town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top, crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Ariake in Nagasaki Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-01.

features.role: Ariake town emblem — a ring with a pointed top, crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised character
